$comment: GENERATED by tools/canon/items.ts from canon/items.yaml and every chapter's `props` — do not edit. Canon is the source of truth (docs/canon-contract.md); run `npm run canon:items`.

brave_whistle.name: Brave Whistle
brave_whistle.text: One loud note. +2 on your next roll.

mosslight_jar.name: Mosslight Jar
mosslight_jar.text: Soft green light. +3 on your next roll.

thunder_acorn.name: Thunder Acorn
thunder_acorn.text: Throw it. It cracks like thunder. 3 damage.

luckstone.name: Luckstone
luckstone.text: Roll a 1? Roll it again. Once each fight.

charm_ford_witch.name: Mother Thrum's Tuned Charm
charm_ford_witch.text: A bell charm tuned to the note the stones hum. Hold it near a gem and it sings.

facet_barge.name: The Barge Stone
facet_barge.text: The one real prop in a mire mimic's act. It hums the same note as the Hollow Gate.

facet_caravan.name: The Caravan Stone
facet_caravan.text: The masterpiece stone of the fattest caravan. It hums so loud the mules wear earmuffs.

facet_clerks.name: The Clerk's Stone
facet_clerks.text: Logged, tagged 4117, and crossing westbound. Then, very irregularly, not.

facet_confiscated.name: The Confiscated Stone
facet_confiscated.text: The loudest stone in the forest's pile. MossHome's record knows who is carrying it.

facet_depot.name: The Depot Stone
facet_depot.text: Its depot tag still says 'Strongbox 9. SOLD.' It rings like a dinner bell.

facet_drakes_rate.name: The Drake's Rate
facet_drakes_rate.text: The newest piece on a river drake's hoard shelf. Marked PAID, underlined twice.

facet_ember.name: The Ember Facet
facet_ember.text: A red stone, warm as toast, that fell from the sky into an Exchange gutter by your boot.

facet_ford.name: The Ford Stone
facet_ford.text: Wrapped in a witch's wool sock. It rings every bell charm it passes, and won't stop.

facet_glade.name: The Glade Stone
facet_glade.text: From the heart of the Woods' worst glade. Warm, loud, and no mosshorn will come near it.

facet_harvest.name: The Harvest Stone
facet_harvest.text: A green-gold stone from a sprites' corner row. It still wears a tiny medal: BEST.

facet_keystone.name: The Keystone
facet_keystone.text: The crown of the seal under Mount Red Sky. Bigger than your head, warm as a sleeping cat.

facet_pride.name: The Pride Stone
facet_pride.text: From the fall no pride will den within a day of. Heavy, warm, and humming.

facet_table.name: The Table Stone
facet_table.text: From the Redspire truth-table. Logged twice. Hums whenever someone tells the truth.

facet_unassigned.name: The Unassigned Stone
facet_unassigned.text: Kept by the grandmothers with the list of caves never assigned. Don't you dare sell it.

hollow_crown_shard.name: Shard of the Hollow Crown
hollow_crown_shard.text: A curl of cold silver. It hums when you are close to the rest of it.

knot_cord.name: MossHome Knot-Cord
knot_cord.text: Old bigfoot knots that say the record knows you. Show it when the forest pays back.

medal_not.name: A Very Small Woven Medal
medal_not.text: Woven by harvest sprites for leaving their stone alone. It says NOT.

ossley_debt_stone.name: Ossley's Wet Stone
ossley_debt_stone.text: A plain river stone, always a little wet. Carry it up, and thank the river.

ossley_reed_knot.name: Ossley's Reed Knot
ossley_reed_knot.text: A reed knot from Old Ossley. "Later. When I'm going your way." It never dries.

tether_chord.name: The Resonance Chord
tether_chord.text: Three notes the choir hums to make the stones hum back. Written down nowhere.

tether_ledger.name: The Cage-Doctrine Ledger
tether_ledger.text: The wardens' plan for holding what is under the mountain. They do not lend it.

tether_question.name: The Witch's Question
tether_question.text: What do you actually want? A witch lent it to you. You may ask it of anything.

torn_map_east.name: Torn Map (East Half)
torn_map_east.text: Half a map, drawn in berry juice. Somebody has the other half.

verses_relay_spiral.name: The Spiral Verses
verses_relay_spiral.text: New route-song verses on bark. Sung in order, the roads curl around the gemfalls.
